question: Who among the following won the Men's Singles event at the US Open 2020 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dominic Thiem**__**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dominic Thiem **won his **first Men's Singles Grand Slam** at US Open 2020

 
 
• He **defeats Alexander Zverev** to win the title. 
 
• He is an **Austrian** professional tennis player.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• There are Four Grand Slams in Tennis which are the **Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon and US Open**.
 
• **Don Budge** was the** first tennis player** to win all** four Grand Slams**.
 
• **Rafael Nadal** has won the **maximum number of Grand Slams (22) in Men's**.
 
• **Serena Williams** has won the **maximum number of Grand Slams (23) in females**.
